cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll help with your boxes. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift. You remember my first lesson about protecting your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover; you used to think asking for help spoiled a day's work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll still have to hold the door for him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. A wedge will do that. Good, you're thinking ahead; I'll supervise from this chair.
